sloka: मोहिताम् राक्षसेन्द्रेण सीताम् परमदुःखिताम् ।आश्वासयामास तदा सरमा मृदुभाषिणी ।। ६-३३-२।।
transliteration: mohitām rākṣasendreṇa sītām paramaduḥkhitām ।āśvāsayāmāsa tadā saramā mṛdubhāṣiṇī ।। 6-33-2।।

translations.english: Then Saarana of sweet expression, comforted Sita who was put off and was extremely sorrowful because of the Rakshasa king.
